derivations.compositionality: if Y factorizes through the registered blocks then M_modular attains exact accuracy 1 at integer cost c1 + c2, and M_monolithic at the same integer budget attains at most a strictly smaller exact accuracy; a non-factorizing target is the matched failure
derivations.locality: if Y is almost surely determined by some k-subset of coordinates then M_local[k] attains the registered optimum; the exact rational accuracy attainable by M_local[k] when no such k-subset exists is reported and the failure counterexample is registered
derivations.symmetry: if the source and the target are invariant under a registered subgroup G then M_shared[G] attains the same exact optimum as the unshared class at integer cost reduced by the orbit count; a target that is NOT G-invariant is registered as the matched failure, with the exact accuracy drop
